experiment_data.hypothesis: Random pruning at k=0.5 on OpenVLA libero_object will show significant performance degradation compared to l2norm-based pruning, confirming that importance-aware pruning preserves more critical weights for task performance.

spec.command: bash -c "cd /root/autodl-tmp/importance_margin_vla_compress && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export MUJOCO_GL=egl && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 && python3 eval_openvla_l2norm_libero.py --mode random_prune --k_ratio 0.5 --suite libero_object --num_episodes 50 --seed 42 --output results/openvla_random_k05_object_seed42.json > /tmp/eval_openvla_random_k05_object_seed42_v2.log 2>&1"
